UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Authenticated SocialSpark user profile storing account contact information.

uid.description: Firebase Authentication user UID matching the document ID.

fullName.description: User full name provided during registration.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was last updated.

/users/{userId}.description: Private user profile documents strictly owned by and readable/writable only by the matching authenticated user.
